schema_version: v0 — skill-charter shape; migrates into the intention envelope when MAP.md Q6 lands
what:
THE SKILL: /chart <something> runs the pre-build preamble as explicit, schema-gated stages — each stage's prompt TEMPLATE-FILLED from the previous stage's validated file, so a skipped stage is a build error, not a lapse. The skill holds the ceiling's loop and the berths; it owns no stage. Its edge is skills/chart/live.py (the doors) and skills/chart/dial.py (the honesty instrument over all of them).

WHAT IT CALLS: The pre-build preamble compiled into QUESTION NEXI — standalone typed units for orient, constrain, survey, decompose, triage, hypothesize, validate (roster OPEN by intention: more nexi and more depth per nexus will be found, not planned). A nexus's anatomy: input + feedback + candidate core questions + domain-specific knowledge + core questions + output — WORKED by a mini agentic loop (think -> act -> observe until the nexus's LOCAL exit condition) that actively assembles the output; never a bare lookup (implicit machinery gets missed — this loop is first-class anatomy). Each nexus is THREE STRATA tried in order: (1) DETERMINISTIC FLOOR — ordinary code: parse, index, convention lookup, cache — with TERRITORY measurement COMPOSED from the orient instrument (cairn/tools/orient, the settled owner of prebuild scans), never a parallel scan; (2) TREE WALK — the nexus's own graph tree via the librarian's tools (deposit / nearest / tree_state; its own table through db_domain); (3) CLAUDE CEILING — the loop, depositing back so the stratum boundary moves DOWN over time. Output is typed JSON with PER-FIELD provenance (floor|tree|claude + confidence); the chain's emitted artifact is the BUILD PACKET (intent / constraints / context / sub-problems / known-vs-novel / success-criteria). Two skills are the UI: /chart <something> chains the landed nexi via SCHEMA-GATED HANDOFFS — each stage's prompt is TEMPLATE-FILLED from the previous stage's validated file, so a skipped stage is a build error, not a lapse; /moreabout <something> is the learning door — a SCOPED expansion resolved from the upstream nexus's already-deposited state (a walk, never a re-run), and the invocation itself is a labeled training signal written back to that nexus's tree. Packets are runtime state and berth in instance-space (~/.cairn/devices/chart/0/); the trees are the durable memory. THE VERDICT (ticket proved-answers-the-chart): the chain's answer module — cairn/devices/builder/machines/verdict/verdict.py, the ONE tree-free validator of the v0 verdict artifact (per-criterion run verdicts with instrument + evidence, per-hypothesis dispositions confirmed|killed with the deciding observation), composed by BOTH mouths: the emit chokepoint's exit gate (fire path, may never reach the trees) and the deposit face in live.py (tree side — the kills land in the hypothesize tree as what-killed-which, the loop deposit_hypothesize's docstring promised). Executing the criteria at PROVED is physics: chart-validate edge (a) LANDED. THE DEPOSIT RIDES THE READ (ticket the-deposit-rides-the-read): the deposit of that verdict is no longer a sail step a builder remembers. The crossing side is tree-free and cheap — an exit-gate-clean forward PROVED crossing appends the answering verdict berth to an APPEND-ONLY PENDING LEDGER (~/.cairn/devices/chart/0/verdict-deposits.jsonl, two record kinds, pending derived by read, never edited), and the crossing's own journal entry carries deposit_enqueued so the obligation and the crossing share an address (Law 5). The tree side pays the db cost at its own door: chart.live's counsel and learn both DRAIN pending berths through the one deposit face before serving — the read is the event, never a clock. Law 7 at that seam: a deposit that raises leaves its enqueued line standing, is named loudly on stderr and in the served payload, and the verb still serves. The latest-claimer rule that decides WHICH artifact answers is factored here (verdict.py claiming_packets) and composed by the exit gate, so an enqueue and a gate can never disagree about it.
why:
Akien's skill-door facts (Akien, 2026-07-28): CC skips steps when the answer looks visible; plain instructions get executed directly rather than routed through a skill; but /skillname fires reliably. So the preamble lives behind the slash-door — the one invocation path with physics rather than discipline behind it. The emitted packet is the inspectable artifact ('so we can inspect and improve what you're getting'); the schema gate at each handoff is the append-door pattern (Law 4).

WHY THE STAGES ARE NOT HERE (decision 2026-08-13-chart-is-a-skill-that-calls-machines). Akien: "chart is a skill, it calls a collection of machines. that's the intention." The measurement that showed the old shape was wrong: eight of the nine legs imported stage 1, and NOT ONE of them touched floor_facts or validate_orient — they took only the shared grammar. Stage 1 looked load-bearing for the whole chain and was not; the coupling was authorship order. Under one directory that was invisible; under the four rungs it is a rung inversion you can measure, and the seven sibling allowlists got SMALLER when it was fixed.

Akien, verbatim — 2026-07-28, the ratifying intent: 'we intend that we can extract debug and grow these specific nexi, knowing we'll find more nexi and more details for each as we go. and the ui shall be /chart <something> --- learning from /moreabout <something>. why: improve the work claude is doing by giving him a more deterministic input.' Sharpened same day: 'so we can inspect and improve what you're getting' — INSPECTABILITY is the load-bearing half: CC's orientation today is invisible reasoning; as a typed packet on disk it can be inspected, diffed, improved. The failure this answers was MEASURED here, not imported: the web-server carrier miss (CC-- 2026-07-28) is premature convergence — proximity to a plausible answer collapsed orient/constrain into pattern-match, bounds-checking never ran to completion. The delivery mechanism follows Akien's observed skill-door facts: CC skips steps when the answer looks visible, plain instructions bypass skills, but /skillname fires reliably — so the preamble lives behind the slash-door as physics, with the handoff schema making each stage unskippable by construction (Law 4). The economics are work-measured: pre-answering the preamble in deterministic code cut build tokens ~89% before caching. AND THE UNIFICATION: 'we'll use the same tools with the librarian. it's agenic loop will just be a simpler form of yours' — the nexi are shared machinery for every Cairn agent, not CC-tooling; one loop shape, two complexity settings.

Nothing about the chain changed; what changed is that /sail no longer refuses for want of berths, it makes them. ONE RUN PER VOYAGE: the second, mid-build run and its drift condition are dropped (skills/sail filed edge (d)).

(g) SETTLED FOR THE VERDICT FACE 2026-07-29 (ticket a-node-holds-one-claim), STILL OPEN FOR THE OTHER SIX. The diagnosis in the open form was wrong in an instructive way: the wall was GRANULARITY, not capacity. A verdict now deposits as its PARTS — one node per criterion verdict and one per disposition (verdict_node_parts), each bare of ticket/berth framing so identical claims from different voyages are the SAME node, with attribution riding provenance. The whole rendering survives as a pure JOIN over the parts, so the two renderings are one function and 'one rendering, no drift' is preserved by construction rather than by care. Nothing is truncated, split, or mean-pooled: THE HOST'S OWN 400 IS THE BOUND, and no character count is consulted anywhere in the deposit path (a source-scan tooth forbids one returning). The 7403/7447 character boundary is now explained rather than memorised — real verdict prose measures 3.71 chars/token against a 2048-token context — because embed_metered_via_domain hands back the host's own prompt_eval_count, which inference_domain had always recorded in its cache row and the seam had always discarded. The pending verdict landed as 8 nodes at 21:33:50; the DEPOSIT FAILED line is gone. WHAT REMAINS OPEN: the other six deposit faces (constrain/survey/decompose/triage/hypothesize/validate and the packet face) still hand ONE unbounded authored rendering to the same seam. They have not been hit because their prose is shorter, not because they are bounded — the largest is well under the ceiling today and nothing stops it growing. The settled answer for each is the same shape as this one (find the natural per-claim grain of that packet), and it is a stone per face, not a sweep.

(g) THE CHART'S LEG VOCABULARY IS NOW WRITTEN DOWN, and a ticket may speak to it — cairn/tools/chain/chain.py, added 2026-07-30 while closing the suite's last red. FINDING: the ticket field `stage_needs` (owned by cairn/tools/base/needs.py, keyed by a node's WORKFLOW vocabulary and carrying MEASURED marks) had been carrying 33 chart-keyed PROSE entries across 12 tickets — 'when you reach survey, settle a3 first'. Two different animals under one name, invisible because 'stage needs' reads plausibly in both dialects: the term survived while the meaning was swapped under it. The needs door was RIGHT to refuse them; its message named only the workflow vocabulary, so for a day the finding read as one stale ticket with a stage called 'orient'. The prose moved to `chart_notes`, gated here because the chart owns its own leg names (Law 6); the needs door now names `chart_notes` in its refusal when the value is a string, and vice versa — a reader who lands on either gate is one field away from right and the message says which way. WHY THE LIST LIVES IN A NEW FILE: the chain order was implicit (each stage module imports the one it reads from), so 'what are the legs, in order' could only be answered by tracing imports — a settled answer being re-derived (Law 1), which a gate cannot afford. chain.py imports nothing; dial.STAGE_FIELDS is bound to STAGES by a tooth rather than by a second copy. IOU: dial should CONSTRUCT its registry from chain.STAGES — that edit touches a proven module and wants a ticket, not a drive-by. COINAGE FLAGGED FOR RATIFY: `chart_notes` is CC's word, not Akien's (a nautical chart carries notes keyed to the leg they bear on; it names the AXIS in the field name, which is exactly what `stage_needs` failed to do). Proof cairn/tools/chain/proofs/test_chart_notes.py, 11 teeth, sealed under netns; four falsifications ran (leg check gutted, shape check gutted, a leg dropped from STAGES, scan stopped at the first offender) and each redded for its own reason.

Filed here because this chain is the RECIPIENT and a recipient that learns of its own inbound edge only by reading another component's charter is exactly the drift these charters exist to stop.
gates: per stone: proof gate under the tester (netns seal), VALIDATION persisted beside-code (validations/), committed. The standing live gate for every nexus: proven against the REAL operational agent — CC on real tasks; orient's score is 'did downstream proceed without re-orienting'. THE DIAL is the honesty gate on the whole intention: per nexus, the fraction of output fields filled by floor vs tree vs claude, over time — a nexus whose floor+tree fraction is not growing is not compiling (Law 3 on the 89% claim).
falsifier: RED on any of: (1) a stage output failing the TEMPLATE-FILL TEST — downstream needed an LLM re-read of upstream prose (the interface was shortened, not compiled); (2) a floor answer crossing from WHAT-EXISTS into WHAT-APPLIES (retrieval reports; only the loop above decides — the harbor-exception drift was a floor-match mis-applied); (3) a packet field without provenance, or confidence as hedging prose instead of data; (4) /moreabout answered by re-running the upstream pass; (5) a monolithic packet-builder (nothing piecemeal to score, shadow, or promote); (6) a nexus scored by its own tree's confidence (home-field manufactured resolution — measured at 0.8295 on the librarian); (7) internal reasoning narrowed to match the output's tightness — LOOSE PROCESS, TIGHT OUTPUT are separate concerns, or parsimony squeezes the wide survey that earns its keep.
horizon: re-read when a deposit face OTHER than the verdict's meets the embed ceiling of edge (g) — the verdict face was settled 2026-07-29 by per-claim granularity and the ledger is empty, but the other six faces are unbounded and merely shorter; re-read when orient v0 has a readable dial from real tasks; when the librarian draws its first shared nexus; when a second consumer (the builder) wants the packet; when Hex is ready to shadow; when /moreabout signals accumulate enough to adjust a parsimony threshold automatically (the tree compiling out a recurring correction, not just logging complaints).
how_it_learns:
THE SKILL'S OWN SURFACE: gate refusals during real use are gate-records for the stage's exit schema — a field the ceiling repeatedly cannot fill honestly is a schema defect, not a discipline defect.

THE CHAIN'S: Learning is this component's SUBJECT, not a sidecar — three mechanisms, all event-driven: (1) DEPOSIT-BACK: every Claude-ceiling assembly deposits into that nexus's tree, so the same question next time is a walk (Law 1 as the runtime loop, inherited from nexus #0); (2) /moreabout AS TRAINING SIGNAL: each scoped expansion is a labeled datum — 'this field, at this compression, wasn't enough for this class' — written back to the upstream tree so the parsimony threshold adjusts per class (LIVE 2026-07-28, ticket moreabout: the signal rides INSIDE the one live verb — un-skippable — and duplicates read as frequency; its walks are also the routine evidence stream for the floor-tuning edge, n=6 by its first day); (3) THE DIAL: per-nexus floor/tree/claude fractions measured over time, the compilation claim kept honest. Distant: shadow/champion promotion moves a whole nexus from Claude to Hex on downstream behavioral evidence — the withdrawal dial with gates instead of vibes. And since 2026-07-29 the loop CLOSES: verdict artifacts deposit kills/confirms back into the hypothesize tree with their deciding observations — counsel now walks to what killed which, not just what was expected.

Akien owns the design ratification (the intent verbatim 2026-07-28, the naming /chart + /moreabout, the librarian unification, the 2026-08-13 skill-calls-machines ruling). Each nexus's tree is its own table through db_domain's gate (Law 6). The packet berth is instance-space — never in git.

counted_by.what_it_counts: one berthed packet per door firing, the door's name as the filename prefix — so this is an EXACT count of chart-door firings, broken out per door. Measured 2026-08-04: 170 firings across eight doors between 2026-07-28 and 2026-08-03, which makes /chart the most-fired skill in Cairn.
counted_by.why_not_the_seam: chart already berths every firing through its own doors. Adding an input_contract would route each firing through cairn.machines.skill_block as well, berthing it twice at two addresses — and then 'how many times did /chart fire' would have two answers that could disagree. A skill is counted where it already leaves a mark; a second mark is not more measurement, it is a second thing to keep in sync (Law 1).
counted_by.the_descending_sequence_is_itself_a_datu: orient 25, survey 24, constrain 23, decompose 22, triage 21, hypothesize 20, validate 19, verdict 16. Twenty-five chains started and sixteen reached a verdict — 64%. Where a chain dies is readable straight off this count and nobody built anything to read it.
